Driving Study Assistant
Examples of examiner commands listed in the DMV materials include:

- “At the corner, turn left” or “At the corner, turn right.”
- “Pull over and stop.”
- “Lane change left” or “Lane change right.”
- “If I don’t say turn, follow the road ahead.”
- “Make necessary lane changes to follow my directions.”
- “Perform all maneuvers only when safe.” [19][20]

These are examples from the **DL 80, revised March 2022**; they are not a guarantee of the exact instructions you’ll hear. [22]
